examShortTricks: Trick 1: Culture questions expect the visible/invisible split: artefacts and festivals vs values and worldview — answer with one of each.
Trick 2: For culture-change questions, argue preservation THROUGH change (adaptation) rather than freezing culture — the nuanced stance scores.
practiceQuestions: Q. How does culture shape identity? (2 marks) — language, rituals and values give belonging; one example.
Q. Should traditions change with time? (2 marks) — yes, adapt their core values to new contexts; keep the meaning, update the form.
keyPoints: Culture is learned, shared and changing — three adjectives examiners expect.
Compare cultural practices across communities without judging them.
